queue.arabic:
فَقُلْتُ لَهُ لَمَّا تَمَطَّى بِصُلْبِهِ
وَأَرْدَفَ أَعْجَازًا وَنَاءَ بِكَلْكَلِ
queue.english:
Then I said to it when it stretched out its spine
And brought forward its hindquarters and rose on its breast
queue.source_citation: Mu'allaqa, line 45. A.J. Arberry, The Seven Odes (1957)

إِنِّي امْرُؤٌ مِنْ خَيْرِ عَبْسٍ مَنْصِبًا
شَطْرِي وَأَحْمِي سَائِرِي بِالمُنْصُلِ
queue.english:
I am a man of the best lineage of Abs on one side
And I protect the rest of me with my blade
queue.source_citation: Mu'allaqa. A.J. Arberry, The Seven Odes (1957)

وَمَنْ لَمْ يُصَانِعْ فِي أُمُورٍ كَثِيرَةٍ

عَفَتِ الدِّيَارُ مَحَلُّهَا فَمُقَامُهَا
بِمِنًى تَأَبَّدَ غَوْلُهَا فَرِجَامُهَا
queue.english:
The abodes are effaced, their halting-place and their dwelling
At Mina, desolate now are its Ghawl and Rijam

وَأَحْسَنُ مِنْكَ لَمْ تَرَ قَطُّ عَيْنِي
وَأَجْمَلُ مِنْكَ لَمْ تَلِدِ النِّسَاءُ
queue.english:
More beautiful than you my eyes have never seen
And more handsome than you no woman has given birth to
queue.source_citation: Diwan Hassan ibn Thabit. Ed. S. al-Barudi. In praise of the Prophet ﷺ

— More beautiful than you my eyes have never seen
And more handsome than you no woman has given birth to

النوع: Madih

بَانَتْ سُعَادُ فَقَلْبِي اليَوْمَ مَتْبُولُ

queue.english:

Lovesick, following her, unredeemed, fettered

وَتَعْظُمُ فِي عَيْنِ الصَّغِيرِ صِغَارُهَا

And great things seem small in the eyes of the great
